text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Thank you for treating me, Maruzen.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
No problemo! Think of it as payback for
going for
a drive with me! ☆

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Sooo, how've things been since?
Everything chill?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, yes. The irritation I felt up until
now has
been blown away, carried off by
the wind.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...You know, I've thought this before,
but you and
I are really similar.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Which is why... you should come to me
when
you're troubled. We'll go for a
drive and blow
your problems away! ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I don't want everything to be about me
every
time, so how about I invite you to
tea next time?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I getcha! Sounds groovy to me, baby! I'll
drink
your tea any day of the week. ☆
